title: Add post-create confirmation alert and View sheet
description: Extend the meal-plan detail view with the successful-create confirmation alert and modal shopping-list presentation flow, including embedding the detail screen in its own NavigationStack with a Done action.
acceptance_criteria: Successful creation shows a `Shopping list created` alert with `View` and `OK` actions.
Choosing `View` presents the newly created shopping list as a sheet driven by the created URL.
The sheet embeds `ShoppingListDetailView` inside a `NavigationStack` and adds a confirmation-action `Done` button that dismisses the sheet.
`MealPlanDetailView` reads `AisleCatalog` from the environment if required for the service call path.

handoff_summary.completed: All four acceptance criteria implemented: success alert with View/OK actions; sheet driven by the created URL; ShoppingListDetailView embedded in NavigationStack with Done button; AisleCatalog already read from @Environment and passed to the sheet via .environment(aisleCatalog).
handoff_summary.risks: No new risks. The sheet uses a boolean + separate URL state rather than sheet(item:) because URL is not Identifiable; this is a deliberate choice to avoid a helper wrapper type.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent for UI flow verification.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No file-scope conflicts expected; this bead only touches MealPlanDetailView.swift.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used @State private var showCreatedSheet = false + createdListURL: URL? rather than sheet(item:) because URL is not Identifiable and adding a wrapper type would be unnecessary scope creep. The sheet injects aisleCatalog (already in scope as @Environment) into the presented NavigationStack so ShoppingListDetailView gets its required environment object.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should verify: (1) creating a list shows the "Shopping list created" alert, (2) tapping "View" opens the sheet with the correct list, (3) "Done" dismisses the sheet, (4) tapping "OK" dismisses the alert without opening the sheet, (5) a duplicate name still shows the error alert.

conflict_risks: No file-scope conflicts expected; this bead only touches MealPlanDetailView.swift.

execution_history.summary: Extended MealPlanDetailView with a post-create confirmation alert and shopping-list sheet. On successful creation the view now captures the returned URL, shows a "Shopping list created" alert with "View" / "OK" buttons, and a "View"-triggered sheet that embeds ShoppingListDetailView inside a NavigationStack with a Done button. AisleCatalog was already wired from the environment and is forwarded to the sheet.
